sources.name: City of Longmont: City Council calendar
sources.notes: Found and read once on 4 October 2026. The City's calendar is The Events Calendar on WordPress. Its robots.txt disallows /wp-json/, so the REST API is not read; the iCal exports under /events/ are allowed, but each stops at 30 items, which on the all-events export is two to four days, nearly all library drop-ins. So the City's calendar is proposed as one feed per department category, each reaching further. This one is the City Council category: 18 items to 29 December on 4 October (council meetings, pre-sessions, study sessions, Coffee with Council, Council at the farmers market, a fire station open house). The City marks a called-off meeting by prefixing "Canceled:" to the title rather than with STATUS:CANCELLED, so ingest will stage those as new items; three in December were marked so. America/Denver times. Exclusions set 4 October 2026 from the event standard in docs/archive/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (storytimes, clubs, drop-ins, classes and routine meetings are not events), with the owner's go-ahead to make Longmont review-ready; remove any to have it staged again. "Council at Longmont Farmers Market" was excluded on 4 October because ingest matched it to the market itself and overwrote one with the other; that matching was fixed on 5 October (a file whose own feed id is still in the run cannot be taken by a similar title), so it is staged again for the editor to judge. Regular council meetings, study sessions and joint meetings excluded on 4 October 2026 at the review, where the owner rejected the eight staged (routine meetings, per the event standard); Coffee with Council and the fire station open house stay.

Exclusions set 4 October 2026 from the event standard in docs/archive/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (storytimes, clubs, drop-ins, classes and routine meetings are not events), with the owner's go-ahead to make Longmont review-ready; remove any to have it staged again. sources.name: Firehouse Art Center
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: SiteGround's bot challenge (sgcaptcha) answers every automated request, so nothing could be read. Check in a browser. Read again 10 November 2026: the site (firehouseart.org, WordPress, robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/) answered a plain request this time, with no bot challenge. Its home page embeds a public Google Calendar (r5a1ofr4s6d7mvuicgvq36l6tc@group.calendar.google.com), whose iCal feed is recorded as feedUrl and the entry typed ical. calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows everything but its front page, so reading this feed weekly needs the editor's robots: subscribe; it was fetched once today to count it. The calendar is the art centre's working diary at 667 4th Ave: 1,219 items since 2013, 20 dated from today on plus about 25 live repeating rules. Worth a row from 10 November to 10 December 2026: the 2nd Friday Exhibit Opening on 13 November (a monthly rule), the Holiday Market on 28 November (entered as "GALLERY HOURS- 12PM- 8PM- Holiday Market", so the GALLERY HOURS exclusion hides it and it wants adding by hand), the 1st Friday Exhibit Opening- FRCC on 4 December and Color Curious on 5 December; 4 in all. Regulars: Poetry Night on the last Friday (27 November) and a Filmmakers Meetup on 1 December. The rest is gallery hours, closures for install, weekly classes (life drawing, clay, tango, watercolor), guild meetings, camps and rentals, which the suggested exclusions cover. A stale monthly rule titled "1st Friday Exhibit Opening- Hangtime" still repeats on second Fridays beside the current "2nd Friday Exhibit Opening-" rule, so two items land on the same night. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): robots: subscribe from the same day, the owner's call: the host's robots.txt disallows the path, and this is the calendar the organization publishes for subscription; one weekly read is what a subscribed calendar does. After the first read, 10 November 2026: the monthly poetry night (a regular, and its rule lands one on Christmas Day) and two placeholder openings whose dates do not match their titles ("2nd Friday Exhibit Opening-", and "1st Friday Exhibit Opening- Hangtime" on second Fridays) are excluded; their staged files were removed.

sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. St. Vrain Cidery, 350 Terry Street, Longmont (the address in the page's own event data). sources.name: Longmont High School (school calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Longmont High School, 1040 Sunset Street, Longmont.
